map.新消费品牌/子品牌线命名：按品类与调性（专业/亲切/高端）生成中英文组合，缩短头: Naming new consumer brands or sub-brand lines: generate Chinese/English combinations by category and tone (professional / friendly / premium) to shorten brainstorming.
map.跨境电商店铺与独立站命名：生成易拼读、易记的英文品牌词，便于海外用户搜索与口碑传: Naming cross-border stores and standalone sites: generate easy-to-pronounce, memorable English brand words for overseas search and word-of-mouth.
map.为系列 SKU 起统一前缀：在母品牌下批量衍生风格一致的子系列名。: Creating a shared prefix for a SKU series: derive consistent sub-series names under the parent brand in bulk.
map.品类填「茶饮」、调性填「国风」，生成「茶语集、青岚、一盏春」等；其中「青岚」二字: Enter the category "tea drinks" and the tone "Chinese style" to generate names such as "ChaYuJi, QingLan, YiZhanChun"; among them QingLan has coherent imagery and a domain like qinglan.com is easy to register, making it suitable for a premium line.
map.品牌名需要注册哪些？: Which categories must the brand name be registered in?
map.核心类目在第 35 类（销售/电商）与产品类（如 30 类食品、25 类服装）注: Register in the core Class 35 (sales/e-commerce) and the product classes (e.g. Class 30 food, Class 25 clothing); for overseas use also check trademarks and domains in the target country, and run a similarity search after generating.
map.中英文品牌名必须一致吗？: Must the Chinese and English brand names match?
map.不必须。很多品牌中文与英文是不同词（如「小米 / MI」），但需保证视觉与发音联: No. Many brands use different words in Chinese and English (e.g. "Xiaomi / MI"), but the visual and phonetic associations should stay consistent to avoid confusing users.
